9e0f4c08c93d1ccb.description: نبحث عن أخصائي إدارة حسابات تواصل اجتماعي مبدع للانضمام إلى فريقنا والمساهمة في تطوير استراتيجيات المحتوى والتفاعل عبر منصات التواصل الاجتماعي. ستكون مسؤولاً عن إنشاء وإدارة حملات تسويقية رقمية مبتكرة، وتحليل الأداء لضمان تحقيق أهداف الشركة. إذا كنت تمتلك شغفاً بالتواصل الرقمي وقدرة على بناء مجتمعات عبر الإنترنت، فنحن ندعوك للتقديم. المهام الرئيسية: * تطوير وتنفيذ استراتيجيات المحتوى لجميع قنوات التواصل الاجتماعي. * إنشاء محتوى جذاب ومتنوع (صور، فيديوهات، نصوص) يتوافق مع هوية العلامة التجارية. * إدارة الحملات الإعلانية المدفوعة على منصات التواصل الاجتماعي. * مراقبة وتحليل أداء الحملات وتقديم تقارير دورية. * التفاعل مع المتابعين والرد على استفساراتهم وتعليقاتهم. * متابعة أحدث الاتجاهات في مجال التسويق الرقمي ووسائل التواصل الاجتماعي.

9eeaa9a82b477f5f.description: About the Role Alpin is seeking a Senior Mechanical Commissioning Engineer (ICA) to lead mechanical commissioning projects in Riyadh. This full-time role involves overseeing the entire commissioning lifecycle, from initial checks to final client handover, ensuring compliance with industry standards and project specifications. Commissioning Leadership and Execution Lead the full lifecycle of mechanical commissioning, including pre-commissioning checks, static testing, Functional Performance Testing (FPT), and final client handover. Develop, review, and approve Commissioning Plans, Method Statements, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), and functional testing scripts for all mechanical systems. Direct and witness Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and Site Acceptance Tests (SAT) for major mechanical equipment. Technical Scope and System Oversight Oversee testing and balancing of Air Handling Units (AHUs), Fan Coil Units (FCUs), Chillers, Cooling Towers, Pumps, Heat Exchangers, and Ventilation Fans. Validate plumbing, drainage, domestic water booster systems, and fire protection networks, including sprinklers, fire pumps, and deluge systems. Coordinate the integration of mechanical equipment with Building Management Systems (BMS), smoke management systems, and life safety controls. Quality, Compliance, and Issue Resolution Ensure all site operations comply with project specifications, ASHRAE guidelines, CIBSE standards, and local statutory requirements. Review mechanical shop drawings, schematic diagrams, and technical submittals to proactively identify coordination or commissioning roadblocks. Track, manage, and drive resolution for all mechanical snags and non-conformance reports using project management and commissioning software such as CxAlloy or Oracle Aconex. Stakeholder Coordination and Reporting Act as the primary technical liaison for mechanical services with clients, main contractors, consultants, and local authorities. Lead technical coordination meetings and deliver regular progress updates to multidisciplinary project teams. Compile and submit comprehensive commissioning documentation, static/dynamic test records, and final O&M handover packages. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, where the Senior Mechanical Commissioning Engineer will be an integral part of Alpin's project teams, ensuring the successful delivery of mechanical commissioning projects.

9e046a699134bc2d.description: About the Role Delta Hotels and Resorts® is seeking a Captain Bellstand to join their team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 0-1 years of experience, focusing on providing exceptional guest service and support within the hotel environment. The role involves direct interaction with guests, ensuring their needs are met efficiently and professionally. Key Responsibilities Greet guests and provide information on property amenities, services, hours of operation, and local attractions. Assist guests and visitors with entering and leaving the property, including opening doors and helping with luggage. Manage luggage storage and retrieval, and transport guest luggage to and from rooms or designated areas. Assist guests with loading and unloading luggage from vehicles and provide directions as needed. Arrange transportation services (*, taxi, shuttle, limousine) for guests and record advance requests. Dispatch bell staff or valet staff as required and communicate parking procedures to guests. Follow up with guests to ensure satisfaction with requests and problem resolution. Leadership and Team Support Serve as a departmental role model and assist management with hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, motivating, and coaching employees. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues. Operational Standards and Guest Service Adhere to all company policies and procedures, reporting accidents, injuries, and unsafe conditions to management. Maintain awareness of undesirable persons on property premises. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, and maintain confidentiality of proprietary information. Welcome and acknowledge all guests, anticipate and address service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and express genuine appreciation. Communicate professionally and clearly, and answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Physical Requirements Ability to read and visually verify information in various formats. Capability to move at a speed required to respond to work situations (*, run, walk, jog). Capacity to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods or an entire shift. Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance, and objects exceeding 75 pounds with assistance. Skill in grasping, turning, and manipulating objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Capability to move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces, as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Ability to reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Additional Duties Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors to support the operational needs of the department.

9e29438e13cee497.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ايساف الدولية عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في نجران. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، وتقدير المواد اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذ الأعمال، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال ومعالجتها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية بأنواعها المنزلية والصناعية والتجارية ومكوناتها بدقة. تقدير كميات المواد والأجهزة المطلوبة وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات، مع التأكد من مطابقة مواصفاتها. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية وتشغيل داراتها، وإجراء الفحوصات اللازمة مثل فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، ومتابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية. تطبيق إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية في جميع مراحل العمل. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الكهربائية المختلفة. معرفة جيدة بأنواع المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية ومواصفاتها. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية وتحديد أسبابها. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في نجران. سيعمل الفني الكهربائي ضمن فريق متخصص، مع التركيز على تنفيذ المشاريع بكفاءة ووفقًا لمعايير السلامة المهنية. ملخص الدور يتطلب هذا الدور فنيًا كهربائيًا ذا خبرة في تمديد وصيانة الأنظمة الكهربائية، مع التركيز على الدقة والالتزام بمعايير السلامة. ستتاح الفرصة للمرشح المختار للعمل في بيئة ديناميكية تساهم في تطوير مهاراته المهنية.

9eb342a9b1a49277.job_title: Sales Specialist (Food and Veterinary PCR Diagnostics)
9eb342a9b1a49277.description: About Haven Scientific Haven Scientific is a Saudi-born company headquartered at the Innovation Cluster of King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) in Thuwal, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The company is the sole manufacturer in the MENA region of genomic tests featuring proprietary designs, offering a diverse range of tests including infectious diseases, genetic testing, and nucleic acid isolations. Haven Scientific is committed to R&D, developing solutions tailored to regional needs, and customizing products for the local market with competitive pricing and in-Kingdom support. The Role: Sales Specialist (Food and Veterinary PCR Diagnostics) Haven Scientific is seeking a proactive Sales Specialist to manage and develop strategic relationships with key clients. This full-time role is responsible for ensuring long-term partnerships, customer satisfaction, and revenue growth. The Sales Specialist serves as the primary point of contact between the company and its key accounts, facilitating effective communication, smooth operations, and timely execution of business activities. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key customers, serving as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts. Understand customer needs, operational requirements, and business objectives. Independently identify, pursue, and close new client opportunities from prospecting to the first purchase order. Develop and manage account plans for assigned key accounts in alignment with the sales manager. Achieve assigned targets for both new client acquisition and existing account growth. Prepare quotations and proposals, coordinating with internal departments for successful order processing. Monitor sales performance and maintain an updated sales pipeline in the CRM system. Ensure all invoices are properly uploaded and recorded, following up with customers for timely payment and collection of outstanding invoices. Provide professional support and timely responses to ensure high levels of customer satisfaction. Coordinate product demonstrations, training sessions, and technical support as required. Work closely with internal teams, including sales management, logistics, technical support, finance, and regulatory departments, to ensure smooth order processing and service support. Monitor customer feedback and market developments, reporting customer requirements, market opportunities, and competitor activities to the Sales Manager. Maintain CRM data accuracy and completeness, logging all client interactions, opportunities, and account activities. Compensation and Benefits Haven Scientific offers a competitive salary and a sales incentive plan tied to target achievement. Employees also receive a personalized Individual Development Plan (IDP), additional paid leave dedicated to professional development activities, and 21 working days of annual leave.

9eee8c7c1c59fea8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة السرر الامريكيه عن بائع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض، قرية العليا. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة وإدارة عمليات البيع اليومية. وهو مناسب للمرشحين الذين يمتلكون خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال المبيعات. الغرض من الوظيفة يتولى البائع مسؤولية بيع مجموعة متنوعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء، وتقديم معلومات شاملة حول المنتجات واستخداماتها وأسعارها. كما يشمل الدور معالجة المدفوعات وضمان تجربة تسوق سلسة للعملاء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع مجموعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء بشكل فعال. توفير معلومات دقيقة ومفصلة للعملاء حول المنتجات، بما في ذلك استخداماتها وميزاتها وأسعارها. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بانتظام، والحفاظ على ترتيب المتجر ونظافته. إصدار طلبات شراء المنتجات عند الحاجة، والتعامل مع المنتجات الواردة وتخزينها بشكل صحيح. تولي أمور الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من العملاء بدقة واحترافية. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات وفقًا لسياسات الشركة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع العملاء وتقديم خدمة ممتازة. مهارات تواصل جيدة والقدرة على شرح تفاصيل المنتجات بوضوح. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، وتحديداً في منطقة قرية العليا. يعمل البائع ضمن بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب التفاعل المستمر مع العملاء وإدارة مهام المبيعات اليومية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

9e11fe8e4f542d55.description: About the Role AECOM is seeking a detail-oriented and collaborative Engineer - Infrastructure to join their team in Al Khafji, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting the planning, design, and delivery of infrastructure projects. The successful candidate will work closely with project teams, contractors, and stakeholders to ensure infrastructure works are executed efficiently, safely, and in compliance with technical specifications and project requirements. Key Responsibilities Support the supervision and monitoring of infrastructure construction activities, including roads, earthworks, drainage systems, and utility networks (water, sewerage, electrical, and telecom). Conduct technical reviews of contractor submissions, including shop drawings, method statements, material submittals, and construction programs. Monitor construction progress, quality standards, and compliance with approved drawings, specifications, and contractual requirements. Perform site inspections, testing, and quality assurance activities to ensure all works meet project standards and specifications. Coordinate with contractors, clients, utility authorities, designers, and other stakeholders to resolve technical issues and maintain project momentum. Prepare and maintain accurate site records, progress reports, inspection documentation, and project files. Analyze construction programs and identify potential delays, risks, or resource constraints that may impact project delivery. Support the review of Inspection Requests (IRs), Requests for Information (RFIs), and Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs). Assist in monitoring interfaces between different infrastructure components to ensure seamless integration. Participate in progress meetings and provide clear, analytical updates on project performance and outstanding works. Ensure compliance with project quality, health and safety, and environmental requirements at all times. Support commissioning activities and handover documentation, including as-built records and operational manuals. Collaborate with the project team to identify innovative solutions and process improvements for infrastructure delivery. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in infrastructure development projects. Demonstrated ability to support the planning, design, and delivery of infrastructure works. Experience in monitoring construction activities, quality standards, and compliance. Proficiency in conducting technical reviews and preparing project documentation. Work Environment and Benefits This position is based in Al Khafji, Saudi Arabia. AECOM offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of its employees. Depending on employment status, benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and an employee stock purchase plan. Salary for this position will be disclosed during the hiring process.

9e6016b3dd58cfbf.description: Position Overview The Associate Commercial Director will provide strategic commercial leadership and oversight of commercial, procurement, and cost management functions across large-scale, complex mega projects in the GCC region. The role involves managing commercial strategies, contractual obligations, procurement activities, cost control, and financial performance to ensure projects are delivered within approved budgets and contractual requirements. The successful candidate will have extensive experience working on major developments within either a Project Management Consultancy (PMC), contracting organization, or a combination of both, with a strong understanding of the GCC construction and infrastructure market. Key Responsibilities Commercial Management: Lead and oversee commercial management activities, including contract administration, commercial negotiations, claims management, variations, and contractual risk mitigation across major projects. Cost Management and Control: Provide strategic oversight of project cost planning, budgeting, forecasting, cost reporting, financial controls, and expenditure monitoring to ensure effective cost management and budget compliance. Procurement Management: Direct procurement strategies, tendering processes, contract negotiations, supplier and subcontractor management, and commercial evaluation to achieve value for money and project objectives. Contract Administration: Ensure effective management of contractual obligations, including payment certifications, change management, claims assessment, dispute resolution, and contractual compliance. Commercial Strategy: Develop and implement commercial policies, procedures, frameworks, and strategies aligned with organizational objectives and project delivery requirements. Financial Performance: Monitor project commercial performance, identify financial and contractual risks, and provide recommendations to senior management on cost optimization and commercial improvements. Stakeholder Management: Establish and maintain effective working relationships with clients, consultants, contractors, subcontractors, and other key stakeholders to resolve commercial issues and protect project interests. Leadership and Governance: Lead, mentor, and develop commercial, procurement, quantity surveying, and cost management teams, ensuring consistent application of commercial standards and best practices. Reporting and Advisory: Provide senior-level commercial advice, management reports, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership on project financial performance, contractual exposure, procurement status, and commercial risks. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Commercial Management, or a related discipline. Minimum 18 years of professional experience in commercial management, procurement, quantity surveying, and cost management within the construction and infrastructure sectors. Extensive experience in managing the commercial aspects of large-scale mega projects within the GCC, preferably in Saudi Arabia. Proven experience working with Project Management Consultancies (PMC), main contractors, or a combination of both. Strong track record in commercial leadership, contract administration, procurement strategy, cost control, claims management, and commercial negotiations. Demonstrated experience managing complex contracts, high-value procurement packages, project budgets, and commercial risks. Extensive knowledge of international contract forms, particularly FIDIC, and GCC construction contractual practices. Experience leading multidisciplinary commercial and procurement teams across complex, multi-package developments. Strong understanding of project financial management, cost forecasting, value engineering, and commercial governance. Excellent leadership, negotiation, stakeholder management, analytical, and decision-making skills. Professional certifications such as MRICS, FRICS, or equivalent commercial or quantity surveying qualifications would be an advantage.

9e814e2cc64c3761.description: Eram Talent is hiring on behalf of its leading Petrochemical client for a Construction Representative to support major petrochemical projects and construction activities. The client is seeking an experienced construction professional with a strong background in petrochemical project execution, construction supervision, quality assurance, and field activities. The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting the planning, execution, monitoring, and completion of construction activities while ensuring compliance with EHS requirements, quality standards, project specifications, schedules, and cost objectives. Key Responsibilities Ensure the construction phase meets EHS, quality, schedule, productivity, and cost objectives. Support the successful planning, execution, supervision, handover, and completion of construction activities in accordance with contracts, specifications, and standards. Coordinate with project, operations & maintenance functions to achieve project goals. Ensure construction safety plans, specifications, procedures, regulatory requirements, and permits are implemented in accordance with Sadara EHS requirements and work processes. Promote a zero-incident culture through safety campaigns, site walks, stand-downs, and related activities. Participate in constructability studies, 3D model reviews, risk reviews, internal progress meetings, root-cause investigations, schedule reviews, audits, and lessons-learned meetings. Support initiation of contractor claims and change-order requests through the Project Lead Engineer when defects, contractual inconsistencies, or scope changes are identified. Ensure implementation of quality control plans and involvement of Asset Integrity experts, where required. Monitor and control construction, including changes, additions, work acceptance, and invoice release. Review job specifications to determine suitable construction methods. Ensure red-lined technical documents are available and reflect the current as-built site condition. Participate in project closeout and provide feedback to design teams and contractors. Participate in contractor qualification and selection, construction strategy development, and handover to commissioning. Matching Construction contractor hours of working will be required, likely needing 6 days working week, overtime & potential night shift activities. Perform other job-related activities requested by the immediate supervisor or manager. Two-year associate degree in a relevant field. Minimum 7 years of experience across phases of chemical or petrochemical projects. 5 years experience of quality checks and field quality assurance activities during construction. Relevant experience in project construction within the petroleum or petrochemical industry. Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications and SAP.

9ed33bda2745c8a4.description: About the Role The Islamic Development Bank (IsDB) is seeking a Senior Ethics Specialist to join its team in Jeddah. This contract position involves contributing to the development and implementation of proactive measures to reduce ethics violations, misconduct, fraud, and corruption within the Bank Group. The role focuses on fostering an ethical environment through awareness, training, and policy support, and requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Monitor and report on prevention activities and programs to ensure compliance with the Bank Group Code of Ethics. Provide policy support for the review and development of internal procedures and manuals within the Group Integrity and Ethics Department (GIED). Integrate ethics into Bank policy documents and engage departments on lessons learned to improve integrity and ethics. Organize and oversee training, capacity building, awareness-raising, and sensitization activities to enhance ethical conduct and prevent staff misconduct. Develop presentations and materials for preventing staff misconduct. Contribute to the launch and implementation of the Financial and Conflict of Interests Program. Conduct staff misconduct investigations and prepare corresponding reports as assigned. Lead the identification and organization of collaborative partnerships with regional and international trainers or experts for staff training programs. Knowledge Management Contributions Support the organization and implementation of meetings, workshops, and video conferences to promote dialogue on integrity, knowledge sharing, and ethics. Provide administrative and technical support to Bank Group staff on ethics-related issues during major events. Contribute to the preparation of a periodic newsletter focused on Ethics Prevention and Outreach Products. Prepare annual integrity and ethics reports on departmental activities and assist in their publication. Contribute to special initiatives and undertake ad hoc assignments as requested. Capacity Building and Advisory Functions Organize and oversee the implementation of training, capacity building, awareness-raising, and sensitization activities for staff misconduct prevention. Design and develop innovative training tools and modules using data mining, media analyses, and compliance reviews. Contribute to the implementation of a Training and Awareness Plan for Bank Group staff. Advise IsDB Group Staff on the provisions of the IsDB Group Code of Ethics. Experience and Qualifications Candidates for this role should possess 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. The position requires a strong understanding of ethics management, integrity frameworks, and the ability to develop and deliver effective training and awareness programs. Experience in conducting investigations and providing policy support is essential. Work Environment This is a contract position based in Jeddah, within the Islamic Development Bank Group. The role involves working collaboratively with various departments and external partners to uphold the highest standards of ethics and integrity across the organization.

9e089dcbdd54f600.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الموئل للاستشارات الهندسية عن مهندس معماري للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على الإشراف على المشاريع المعمارية المتنوعة، بدءًا من المباني السكنية الجديدة وصولاً إلى ترميم الممتلكات القائمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف المباشر على مشاريع المباني السكنية الجديدة، بالإضافة إلى الإضافات والتعديلات على المباني القائمة. تقديم الاستشارات المتخصصة في مجال ترميم الممتلكات القديمة والمحافظة عليها. المساهمة في اختيار المواقع المناسبة للمشاريع ومباشرة أعمال الإنشاءات. إدارة فريق التصميم فيما يتعلق باختيار المواد وتطوير المواصفات الفنية للمشاريع. إعداد النماذج بالحجم الطبيعي والرسومات الفنية والنماذج الرقمية. المساعدة في عملية اختيار المقاولين والمواد اللازمة للمشاريع. تقديم الدعم المستمر لمشروعات الإنشاءات ومتابعة تنفيذ التصميم من قبل المقاولين. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الهندسية المتخصصة، وتوضيح نسب تقدم الأعمال، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة وفقًا للسياسات والإجراءات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال الهندسة المعمارية. فهم عميق لمراحل تصميم وتنفيذ المشاريع المعمارية. القدرة على إعداد الرسومات والنماذج الفنية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق عمل شركة الموئل للاستشارات الهندسية. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهندسين المعماريين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة الموئل للاستشارات الهندسية.

9e504614d8ee7882.description: About the Role Haji Husein Alireza & Co. Ltd. is seeking a Senior Consultant Application (EWM) to lead the design, configuration, rollout, and support of SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) on S/4HANA across the company's warehouses. This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. The role focuses on delivering a reusable warehouse template to improve inventory accuracy, picking accuracy, and overall warehouse productivity. Key Responsibilities Lead fit-to-standard workshops with warehouse operations, logistics, and after-sales teams, ensuring all identified gaps are resolved and business requirements are signed off. Design a standard warehouse template covering inbound, outbound, and internal processes, aiming for significant reuse across warehouses. Assess deployment and licensing options for EWM, providing costed recommendations to the ERP Program Manager. Maintain the EWM design decision log under version control, documenting all decisions with rationale and approver. Configure warehouse structure (storage types, sections, bins, activity areas, work centers) and all inbound, outbound, and internal processes. Design cross-docking, returns, and kitting processes as required within the build plan. Define and test integration with MM, SD, QM, service, and finance, resolving critical defects before UAT exit. Integrate EWM with vehicle sales and service solutions for parts demand and workshop supply. Specify warehouse infrastructure requirements (Wi-Fi, RF handhelds, label printers, bin labeling) for all in-scope sites. Prepare functional specifications for all EWM WRICEF objects and validate technical delivery. Lead proof of concept, integration testing, UAT, and cutover for each warehouse, ensuring go-live readiness. Lead migration of warehouse master data, bins, and stock, achieving reconciliation between physical and system stock at cutover. Lead hypercare for each warehouse, resolving incidents within SLA and ensuring a stable handover to support. Support and Capability Building Train warehouse supervisors and key users before go-live, providing approved work instructions and SOPs. 9e710367ba98b222.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سراكو عن فني هندسة كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في بريدة، القصيم. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب ومراقبة المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية، بالإضافة إلى تقديم الدعم للمهندسين الكهربائيين في حل المشكلات الفنية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد المخطط وكمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة بناءً على المخططات الأولية للمشاريع. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والفنيين والحرفيين الآخرين فيما يتعلق بأعمال تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية. اختبار الأنظمة الكهربائية بعد تركيبها لضمان التزامها بالمخطط الأولي والمواصفات المطلوبة. إجراء عمليات الفحص الروتينية كجزء من الصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص الأعطال والتلف المحتمل، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. التحقق من الأعطال وفحص الأجزاء والمعدات المعطوبة، وتشخيص المكونات التالفة وإصلاحها أو استبدالها. ضمان الاستجابة السريعة لعمليات الطوارئ للتقليل من فترات انقطاع التيار الكهربائي. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الكهربائية والفنية. معرفة قوية بتركيب وصيانة المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية. مهارات تشخيص الأعطال واستكشاف الأخطاء وإصلاحها. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة بريدة بمنطقة القصيم. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص، ويقدم الدعم المباشر للمهندسين الكهربائيين لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية المسمى الوظيفي: فني هندسة كهربائية. الشركة: شركة سراكو. الموقع: بريدة، القصيم. نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقدم لهذه الفرصة.

9eb3abcd0c5f4a04.company_name: King Faisal Specialist Hospital & Research Center (KFSH) | مستشفى الملك فيصل التخصصي
9eb3abcd0c5f4a04.description: About the Role Johns Hopkins Aramco Healthcare (JHAH) is seeking a General Surgeon specializing in Surgical Oncology to join their team in Dhahran. This full-time position requires 3-5 years of relevant experience and focuses on providing high-standard, cost-effective general surgical care to eligible recipients within JHAH. The role involves duties within the area of expertise and competence as approved by the hospital's Credential & Privileging Authority. Key Responsibilities Provide attending and consulting general surgical care. Participate in service clinical and educational rounds, including morning reports and sign-out rounds. Attend and contribute to multi-disciplinary team rounds. Engage in service/department Quality and Safety activities, including reviews, audits, and presentations. Report patient adverse events to the appropriate department/service office. Prepare and provide patient reports in accordance with hospital policy. Participate in assigned committees and adhere to hospital and departmental policies. Delegate and supervise house staff, nursing staff, and operative procedures as appropriate. Contribute to teaching and educational activities for junior staff, medical students, and interns. Ensure legible and timely entries into patient records, maintaining confidentiality. In-patient Duties Admit patients from the Emergency Room, out-patient clinics, and other hospitals. Conduct daily rounds on assigned patients during workdays. Foster teamwork and collaborate with all involved healthcare professionals. Ensure assigned in-patients receive care during weekends and holidays as per on-call arrangements. Respond to emergency calls and attend to patients in a timely manner. Participate in trauma care according to established roles. Answer in-patient consultations within the required timeframe. Carry out appropriate discharge procedures and consult with colleagues as needed. Participate in rotational 24-hour on-call coverage. Out-patient Duties Attend to assigned out-patient surgical and procedural clinics punctually. Collaborate with the out-patient care nursing team and other professionals to optimize patient benefits. Refer patients to other services as appropriate. Operating Room Duties Ensure patients are adequately prepared for required surgery. Maintain punctuality and professionalism within the operating room. Ensure appropriate operative notes are dictated in a timely manner. Keep patient caregivers/guardians informed about procedure outcomes. Follow operating room policies and procedures for patient processing. Work closely with anesthesia colleagues to ensure patient safety during the perioperative period. Professional Interactions The General Surgeon reports to the Division/Unit Head and the Department Chair within the Department of Surgery. Daily interactions include patients, with consultations provided to other specialists on major or complicated surgical cases. Frequent contact is maintained with personnel from surgical services, nurses, and physicians for information exchange and problem resolution. Occasional contacts are made with counterparts in other Middle Eastern/Saudi Arabian medical facilities for consultation and advice regarding clinical evaluation and follow-up of JHAH patients.

9eec3c95bd8c097e.description: About KEENFINITY KEENFINITY is a globally leading provider of innovative and professional security and communication solutions, with over 4,000 employees across more than 50 countries. The company focuses on securing, connecting, and amplifying important moments through technology. KEENFINITY fosters a work environment built on trust, appreciation, and accountability, encouraging a customer-focused approach and strong team spirit. Inside Sales Internship, Telecommunication KEENFINITY is seeking a motivated and enthusiastic Inside Sales Intern in Telecommunication for its IQSIGHT division in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This internship, intended for Saudi Nationals and recent Telecommunication Engineering graduates, offers hands-on experience in B2B sales, CRM management, lead generation, and sales operations. The intern will support the sales team in generating new business opportunities, nurturing leads, and maintaining customer relationships, working alongside experienced sales professionals. Key Responsibilities Research and identify prospective customers across target industries. Generate and qualify sales leads through phone calls, emails, LinkedIn, and other outreach channels. Schedule meetings and product demonstrations for the sales team. Maintain accurate customer and prospect information in the CRM system. Follow up with potential customers to understand their requirements and nurture leads. Assist in preparing sales presentations, proposals, quotations, and reports. Support sales campaigns and promotional activities. Collaborate with the marketing and customer success teams to improve lead conversion. Track daily, weekly, and monthly sales activities and prepare performance reports. Stay updated on company products, industry trends, and competitor activities. Internship Benefits Practical experience in inside sales and business development. Exposure to CRM systems and modern sales tools. Mentorship from experienced sales professionals. Opportunity to build professional communication and negotiation skills. Certificate of Internship (subject to successful completion). Potential opportunity for a full-time role based on performance. Learning and development opportunities. Professional mentoring and networking exposure. Flexible working environment (based on company policy). Candidate Requirements This internship is open to Saudi Nationals, with a preference for recent Telecommunication Engineering graduates. Candidates should be motivated and enthusiastic, with 0-1 years of experience. Company Culture KEENFINITY is committed to shaping a smarter, more connected world through technology. The company values diverse backgrounds, ideas, and experiences, fostering an environment where everyone is respected, valued, and encouraged to be their authentic self. KEENFINITY is dedicated to growing, learning, and celebrating success as one team.

9e3ba4906c4b481c.description: About Air Products Qudra and BHIG Air Products Qudra is a joint venture that reimagines possibilities through the collective experience and motivation of its people. The company focuses on creating solutions that support various industries, from space exploration to healthcare and the construction of world-scale production facilities. BHIG—Blue Hydrogen Industrial Gases—is a regional development and investment joint venture between Saudi Aramco and Air Products Qudra, leveraging the combined strengths of both entities to drive industrial innovation and operational excellence across Saudi Arabia and the region. BHIG is committed to supporting clean energy goals through low-carbon hydrogen production. Role Summary: Assistant Site Manager The Assistant Site Manager will be based in Al Jubail and is responsible for managing and supervising the operations of a facility that includes an Air Separation Plant, a Hydrogen Steam Methane Reformer, a CO2 unit, compression systems, a Steam Turbine Generator, and all associated ancillary and utility equipment, along with a merchant facility and pipeline network. This full-time role requires 10 years of experience and reports directly to the Site Manager. Key Responsibilities Support the Site Manager in supervising operations staff, including shift supervisors and operators. Ensure daily operational targets are achieved and maintain safe and reliable site operations by interfacing with Maintenance and Engineering teams. Provide and maintain a safe work environment, demonstrating leadership in company and industry safe work processes. Ensure adherence to company HSSE policy and procedures, and meet all environmental regulatory requirements. Provide technical direction and guidance for troubleshooting, maintenance, repair, and testing activities. Manage plant production efficiently based on data-driven decisions to meet safety and reliability targets. Ensure the safety of all operations and maintenance personnel through the BHIG Basic Safety Practice program. Meet customer satisfaction targets for safety, reliability, product quality, and supply flexibility. Verify and approve SAP notifications with accurate basic data and participate in pre-work visits with Maintenance and Contractors. Participate in preparing maintenance or process shutdowns and turnarounds, including scope definition and prioritization. Manage and organize regular equipment testing and routine preventive maintenance. Release work permits, ensure all precautions are fulfilled, and maximize safe work permit practices. Conduct risk assessments and participate in unusual operational or maintenance activities. Provide coaching and motivation to the operations team to achieve operational excellence. Lead or participate in incident investigations and Root Cause Analysis, implementing sustainable corrective actions. Act as the Single Point of Contact for internal facility issues, coordinating internal resources. Qualifications and Experience 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Proven coordination experience in a multi-team environment, including operations, engineering, and maintenance. Strong leadership, interpersonal, and teamwork skills with effective communication abilities across all organizational levels and externally. Ability to foster a 'one team' environment. Capability to communicate and manage customer interactions daily. Extensive technical knowledge in operations, engineering, and maintenance activities. Understanding of local environmental and health and safety requirements. Work Environment This is a full-time position located in Al Jubail, requiring active participation in managing and supervising a complex industrial facility. The role involves close collaboration with various internal teams, including engineering and maintenance, and external stakeholders to ensure operational excellence and customer satisfaction. Application Information Candidates meeting the specified qualifications are encouraged to apply for this role to contribute to BHIG's commitment to industrial innovation and clean energy goals.

9e692f9708af3872.description: About the Role Le Méridien Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Restaurant Manager I to oversee daily restaurant operations in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves managing restaurant, bar, and room service functions, focusing on guest and employee satisfaction, and optimizing financial performance. The role requires 2-5 years of experience in the food and beverage industry. Key Responsibilities Supervise and manage daily restaurant, bar/lounge, and room service operations, ensuring adherence to service and sanitation standards. Assist with menu planning and maintain high sanitation standards across all food and beverage areas. Support servers and hosts on the floor during peak meal periods to ensure smooth service delivery. Review staffing levels to meet guest service needs, operational requirements, and financial objectives. Identify and implement training needs for the team, ensuring continuous improvement in knowledge and skills. Ensure compliance with all food and beverage policies, standards, procedures, and applicable laws and regulations, including food handling, sanitation, and liquor laws. Leadership and Team Development Lead by example, demonstrating honesty, integrity, and sound financial decision-making. Foster mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members. Coach, mentor, and guide employees to enhance their performance and professional development. Set clear goals and expectations for the team, prioritizing tasks effectively. Provide guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring progress. Ensure fair and equitable treatment of employees and strive to improve employee retention. Guest Service Excellence Ensure exceptional customer service, managing daily operations to meet and exceed guest expectations. Act as a guest service role model, creating a positive atmosphere and handling guest problems and complaints effectively. Gather feedback from guests on food and beverage quality, service levels, and overall satisfaction to drive continuous improvement. Manage service delivery from arrival to departure, including greeting, order taking, food and beverage delivery, special requests, and cashiering. Qualifications and Experience High school diploma or GED with 4 years of experience in food and beverage, culinary, or a related professional area. Alternatively, a 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or a related major, with 2 years of experience in food and beverage, culinary, or a related professional area. Additional Responsibilities Communicate effectively with supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates through various channels. Analyze information and evaluate results to identify optimal solutions and resolve operational issues. Oversee daily shift operations in the absence of the Assistant Restaurant Manager. Manage financial aspects of the department, including purchasing and invoicing.

9ec1425eb86851f9.description: About the Role Leylaty Group is seeking a Sous Chef (French Italian Mediterranean Cuisine) to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves assisting the Head Chef in managing kitchen operations, supervising staff, and ensuring the preparation of high-quality dishes. The position requires strong expertise in French or Italian Mediterranean cuisine, with a focus on authenticity, consistency, and presentation, contributing to maintaining kitchen efficiency, safety, and cleanliness. Key Responsibilities Assist the Head Chef in planning, developing, and executing menus, with a focus on French or Italian Mediterranean cuisine. Supervise kitchen staff and ensure proper food preparation, cooking techniques, and presentation standards. Monitor food quality, taste, and consistency to meet brand and culinary standards. Ensure adherence to all health, safety, and food hygiene regulations. Manage inventory, order supplies, and control food costs efficiently. Train and mentor kitchen staff on culinary techniques, recipes, and plating standards. Assist in scheduling staff shifts and managing daily kitchen operations. Maintain high levels of cleanliness and sanitation in all kitchen areas. Handle customer feedback, special dietary requests, and complaints when required. Support the Head Chef in fostering a positive, disciplined, and efficient kitchen environment. Qualifications and Experience Proven experience of 5-10 years as a Sous Chef or in a similar senior kitchen role. Strong hands-on experience in French or Italian Mediterranean cuisine is mandatory. A culinary degree or equivalent professional certification is preferred. In-depth knowledge of culinary techniques, food safety, and sanitation standards. Required Skills Strong leadership, communication, and team management skills. Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced, high-volume kitchen environment. Creativity, attention to detail, and passion for Mediterranean culinary arts. Work Environment The Sous Chef will operate within a dynamic kitchen environment, supporting the Head Chef in all aspects of culinary operations. The role demands a commitment to maintaining high standards of quality, safety, and efficiency in a fast-paced setting. Application Process Further details regarding the application process and salary will be disclosed upon inquiry.

9e507e4125c4f490.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مصرف الراجحي عن استشاري مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقه في المنطقة الغربية، بمدينة جدة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى عرض وبيع المنتجات والخدمات المصرفية للعملاء، مع الحفاظ على أعلى مستويات الجودة والاحترافية في الخدمة المقدمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال طلبات بيع المنتجات المصرفية ومتابعة إدخالها وتنفيذها على الأنظمة المعتمدة. مساعدة العملاء في فتح الحسابات، استيفاء المستندات المطلوبة، وإدخال البيانات والتوقيعات في النظام، وطلب تعميد مدير العمليات. ترحيل العقود والحسابات عبر البريد إلى مركز المعلومات وعلى نظام إدارة المستندات (DMS). الترحيب بالعملاء عند دخول الفرع وتقديم الخدمة المطلوبة لهم. مساعدة العملاء في تعبئة النماذج اللازمة عند الحاجة. توجيه العملاء لإتمام معاملاتهم بشكل صحيح، وشرح كيفية تنفيذ العمليات المتاحة عبر أجهزة الصراف الآلي والقنوات الإلكترونية الأخرى. توجيه العملاء إلى الموظف المختص حسب طبيعة استفسارهم أو طلبهم. الاستجابة السريعة لمعالجة مشاكل العملاء وتلبية طلباتهم وفقاً لإجراءات وتعليمات العمل، والمتابعة مع مراقب الفرع لحل المشاكل. استلام طلبات بطاقات الصراف الآلي، إدخالها في النظام، طباعة البطاقات الفورية، وتسليم البطاقات المجددة للعملاء. استقبال طلبات تحديث بيانات العملاء. استلام طلبات إغلاق الحسابات وتعديل بياناتها، وتسليمها لمدير العمليات لإدخالها في النظام. استقبال العملاء الموكلين، استكمال بيانات نموذج التوكيل، مطابقة التوقيع، إدخاله في النظام، وطلب تعميد مدير العمليات. استيفاء الأوامر المستديمة للعملاء، إنشاء وتنشيط العضويات، وتحويلها لمدير العمليات لاستكمال إجراءات تنفيذها. التعامل مع طلبات تغيير التوقيع وطلبات تحريك الحسابات. إدخال المطالبات المتعلقة بالصراف الآلي ونقاط البيع في نظام مطالبات بطاقات الصراف الآلي. استقبال مشاكل العملاء وتحويلها لمدير العمليات للعمل على حلها. الاستعلام عن البطاقات الائتمانية وبطاقات الصراف الآلي المسحوبة من الصراف الآلي بالفرع، وتوجيه العميل لاستلامها من كبير الصرافين. تزويد العملاء بالمنشورات التعريفية بالمنتجات. رفع بلاغات الاشتباه في غسل الأموال وحالات الاحتيال، والإبلاغ عن الحالات المخالفة للأنظمة والتعليمات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 1 إلى 5 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة والتعامل باحترافية. مهارات تواصل قوية وفعالة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مصرف الراجحي في مدينة جدة بالمنطقة الغربية، ويوفر بيئة عمل داعمة تهدف إلى تحقيق الأهداف المصرفية وتقديم أفضل الخدمات للعملاء. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: غير معلن. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة ضمن فريق مصرف الراجحي.

9e7b5d59155994a6.description: About the Role ArcelorMittal Tubular Products Al-Jubail is seeking an Accountant Profitability and Cost Performance to join their team in Al Jubail, Eastern region. This full-time role is responsible for supporting profitability reporting, manufacturing cost analysis, variance analysis, intercompany costing support, and dashboard preparation activities for the company's subsidiaries and affiliated entities. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Purpose and Context The Accountant, Profitability & Cost Performance, supports the Lead in generating accurate and timely analytical reports. This involves extracting, validating, and analyzing SAP and operational data across subsidiaries to provide visibility into product profitability, manufacturing cost performance, subsidiary operational performance, intercompany cost and margin analysis, sales backlog profitability, Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ), and operational cost drivers. The role is key to ensuring reporting standardization, data consistency, and analytical alignment with corporate reporting requirements. Key Responsibilities Support the preparation of monthly profitability reports for subsidiaries using SAP CO-PA and related systems. Prepare profitability dashboards and analytical reports by subsidiary/entity, customer, sales order, product category, and region. Analyze profitability performance across subsidiaries and identify major margin deviations. Support monthly manufacturing cost performance analysis against standard cost, budget, and prior periods. Analyze operational cost drivers, including material consumption, yield losses, utility consumption, cycle times, and rework & scrap. Prepare monthly backlog profitability reports and dashboards for subsidiary operations. Support the preparation of RFQ costing models and profitability simulations for subsidiary products and operations. Prepare monthly COPQ analysis and supporting reports for subsidiary operations. Develop and maintain dashboards using Excel, Power BI, SAP, or other reporting tools for subsidiary reporting requirements. Support internal and external audit activities by preparing required reports, reconciliations, and supporting schedules related to costing and profitability. Data Analysis and Reporting Validate data accuracy and reconcile subsidiary reporting outputs with Finance and Operations teams. Coordinate with subsidiary Operations, Production, and Finance teams to collect required operational and financial data. Prepare variance analysis reports with supporting explanations for subsidiary management and corporate finance teams. Ensure reporting visibility by customer, order, product, region, and segment for backlog profitability. Collect and validate operational and quality-related data from relevant stakeholders within subsidiaries for COPQ analysis. Extract and validate SAP data required for audit requests. Standardization and Compliance Assist in standardizing profitability reporting methodologies across subsidiaries. Support standardization of costing and performance reporting methodologies across subsidiaries. Support alignment of costing methodologies between subsidiaries and ArcelorMittal Tubular Products Al-Jubail. Ensure data consistency, reporting accuracy, and alignment with corporate reporting standards. Support compliance with corporate finance policies, costing procedures, and reporting standards across subsidiaries. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a relevant accounting or finance role. Proficiency in SAP CO-PA and other related systems. Experience with data extraction, validation, and analysis. Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify major margin deviations and operational cost drivers. Experience in developing and maintaining dashboards using tools like Excel and Power BI.

9eaec1f5bc75f92e.company_name: وكالة وقت الاجازة للسفر و السياحة
9eaec1f5bc75f92e.description: تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة والنماذج الخاصة بمراقبة دوام الموظفين، والمساهمة في والإشراف على تطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الإجازات المرضية والطارئة، وتحديث المعلومات المتعلقة بالموظفين والتعامل مع شكاويهم واستفساراتهم بمهنية وإعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة والمتعلقة في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية وعرضها وحفظها.

9e257982352fdf46.description: About The Company GE Vernova is an energy company focused on helping build, power, and decarbonize the world. Its work spans power generation, wind, electrification, and related technologies and services. Teams across the company contribute to energy systems that support customers, communities, and industries around the globe. Working at GE Vernova means collaborating with colleagues who bring varied technical and professional expertise to complex challenges across the energy value chain. The company’s purpose is reflected in its focus on reliability, innovation, and the energy transition. About The Role GE Vernova is seeking a motivated professional to contribute to work that supports the delivery of energy solutions for customers. 9e56bf7a79b8811c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ركن الكسائي الطبي عن مراجع داخلي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تخطيط وتنفيذ أعمال المراجعة الداخلية للأنشطة المالية والإدارية والتشغيلية والطبية في الشركة وفروعها. يتضمن الدور تقييم فعالية أنظمة الرقابة الداخلية وإدارة المخاطر والامتثال للوائح، مع تقديم التوصيات اللازمة لتحسين الأداء وحماية الأصول. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تخطيط عمليات المراجعة الداخلية ومتابعة تنفيذها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. تقييم فعالية أنظمة الرقابة الداخلية وإدارة المخاطر، واقتراح الإجراءات التصحيحية والتحسينية. إعداد تقارير المراجعة الداخلية وتوثيق الملاحظات والمخاطر والتوصيات ورفعها إلى لجنة المراجعة. تقييم الالتزام بالإجراءات والسياسات المؤسسية ومختلف العمليات المتعلقة بإدارة المخاطر. تحليل المعلومات والبيانات للتأكد من تطبيق الأنظمة واللوائح المالية، وإبلاغ الإدارة بأي خلل. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة لنتائج المراجعة، وتقديم التوصيات، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات. متطلبات الخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المراجعة الداخلية أو مجال ذي صلة. المهارات والكفاءات القدرة على تقييم أنظمة الرقابة الداخلية وإدارة المخاطر. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحليل البيانات والمعلومات المالية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير المهنية وتقديم التوصيات بوضوح. الالتزام بالأنظمة واللوائح والسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. مهارات تواصل فعالة لتقديم الملاحظات والتوصيات للإدارة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، وتتطلب الوظيفة التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق المراجعة الداخلية في شركة ركن الكسائي الطبي. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

9e83cb3dd87c6f4b.description: The Role The Clinical Dietitian is responsible for planning, delivering and evaluating nutrition care services for patients across assigned clinics. You will provide Medical Nutrition Therapy, monitor clinical nutrition parameters, support food service quality and contribute to quality improvement initiatives. You will report to the Clinic Manager and work closely with the Head of Nutrition Care, physicians, nurses and the wider multidisciplinary team What You Will Do Deliver Medical Nutrition Therapy tailored to hemodialysis patients with different backgrounds, age groups and medical conditions. Implement the Nutrition Care Process, including screening, assessment, diagnosis, intervention, counselling, monitoring and evaluation. Identify and manage nutrition-related conditions including malnutrition, protein-energy wasting (PEW), sarcopenia, obesity, diabetes and other chronic conditions. Monitor clinical, biochemical and nutritional parameters and develop individualised nutrition care plans. Utilise digital tools, AI-enabled technologies and body composition assessment devices where available to support nutritional assessment, monitoring and clinical decision-making. Maintain accurate documentation, including Monthly Care Plans, nutritional assessments, follow-ups and referrals. Participate in nutrition audits, quality improvement initiatives and monitoring of nutrition outcome indicators. Collaborate effectively with the multidisciplinary team to support comprehensive patient care. Support the orientation, education and development of dietitians, interns and colleagues. Stay updated on renal nutrition, malnutrition, sarcopenia, digital health and emerging technologies in clinical nutrition Desired Candidate Profile You are clinically precise, patient-focused and forward-thinking. You understand that nutrition in dialysis is complex and requires both strong technical knowledge and effective patient communication. You will be well-suited to this role if you: Deliver evidence-based nutrition care with accuracy and genuine patient focus. Communicate effectively with patients and healthcare professionals. Recognise nutritional risk early and take appropriate action. Are comfortable using digital tools and open to AI and technology-enabled clinical practice. Take initiative in quality improvement and continuous learning. Work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team. What we need: Bachelor's degree in Clinical Nutrition. Master's degree is an advantage. Valid SCFHS classification/registration as a Clinical Dietitian Specialist. Fluent in Arabic and English, spoken and written. Proficient in MS Office and basic computer systems. Clinical dietetics experience in a hospital or healthcare setting. What you need to be able to do: Bachelor's degree in Clinical Nutrition. Master's degree is an advantage. Valid SCFHS classification/registration as a Clinical Dietitian Specialist. Fluent in Arabic and English, spoken and written. Proficient in MS Office and basic computer systems. Clinical dietetics experience in a hospital or healthcare setting. What gives you an edge: Experience in renal nutrition, diabetes or chronic disease management. Knowledge of malnutrition, PEW and sarcopenia. Experience with body composition analysis, nutrition assessment technologies or digital clinical tools. Familiarity with HACCP and foodservice management. Experience with nutrition outcome indicators, research or quality improvement projects.

The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Develop and modify designs for gate valves, hammer unions, OCTG products, API wellhead and pressure-control equipment, and wireline tools. Prepare and review engineering drawings, 3D models, calculations, BOMs, specifications, and Design Verification Reports within delegated authority. Perform design verification, material selection, tolerance evaluation, and value-engineering assessments in line with applicable requirements. Process engineering changes, controlled document updates, and product lifecycle records in the PLM or approved document-control system. Provide technical input for customer inquiries, quotations, bids, product applications, contract reviews, and sales-order feasibility assessments. Prepare technical clarifications, datasheets, catalogues, presentations, and troubleshooting guidance, escalating exceptions when required. Coordinate with Manufacturing on manufacturability, route cards, tooling, process instructions, assembly, and testing requirements. Support Procurement with material specifications, technical bid evaluations, vendor clarifications, and certification or traceability requirements. Work with Quality on ITPs, acceptance criteria, nonconformities, CAPA, root-cause analysis, and audit evidence. Apply API 6A, 16A, 16C, 5CT, and 5B requirements and relevant ASME, NACE, ISO, and customer specifications. Support API monogram, customer, internal, and external audits and maintain complete, current, and traceable engineering records. Identify design, quality, lead-time, and cost improvements and share lessons learned with engineering and operational teams. Accountabilities Accuracy, completeness, and timely delivery of assigned drawings, models, calculations, BOMs, specifications, and verification records. Compliance of assigned engineering outputs with approved design inputs, API standards, customer requirements, and document-control procedures. Effective technical support for quotations, customer inquiries, manufacturing, procurement, quality, and field-service requirements. Timely identification and escalation of design risk, nonconformity, feasibility constraints, technical deviations, and approval requirements. Maintaining traceable product data, engineering-change records, design files, and audit evidence. Contribution to measurable improvements in product reliability, manufacturability, quality, cost, and lead time. Qualifications and Experience Education: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or a closely related engineering discipline. Industrial Design may be considered where supported by relevant product-engineering experience. Experience: 4–8 years of relevant experience in product engineering, design development, and technical support within an Oil & Gas manufacturing, service, or repair environment. Demonstrated experience independently delivering moderately complex engineering assignments and supporting API, customer, or quality audits. Technical Knowledge and Skills Strong knowledge of gate valves, hammer unions, OCTG products and connections, wellhead and pressure-control equipment, or wireline tools. Practical knowledge of API 6A, 16A, 16C, 5CT, and 5B, with awareness of ASME, NACE MR0175/ISO 15156, ISO, and customer requirements. Good understanding of CNC machining, welding, assembly, hydrostatic and gas testing, material selection, certification, and traceability. Strong proficiency in 3D CAD software such as SolidWorks or Inventor and familiarity with engineering calculation or FEA tools. Working knowledge of PLM, ERP/SAP, engineering change, and controlled-document workflows. Sound analytical, problem-solving, technical-writing, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to manage concurrent assignments, collaborate cross-functionally, work independently within delegated authority, and support junior engineers when required. Application Information The salary for this position will be commensurate with experience and qualifications, and will be disclosed during the interview process.

9ef68f8e9b68fe89.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة دار المعدات الطبية والعلمية عن فني مختبر طبي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إجراء الفحوصات المخبرية الدقيقة للعينات، والمساهمة في تقديم نتائج موثوقة لدعم التشخيص الطبي. تتطلب الوظيفة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، مما يجعلها فرصة مناسبة للخريجين الجدد أو ذوي الخبرة المحدودة في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تفقد وتشغيل وصيانة معدات حفظ وفحص العينات، وضبطها وفقاً لنوع الفحص المطلوب ومراقبة أدائها. دراسة طلبات الأطباء لتحديد الفحوصات المطلوبة، وسحب عينات الدم، واستلام عينات البول والبراز، مع تدوين بيانات المرضى عليها وحفظها بالطرق الصحيحة. تحضير العينات للفحص والزراعة، واختيار مواد الفحص بالكميات والمواصفات المطلوبة، وإجراء الفحوصات المختلفة بما في ذلك التحاليل الكيميائية والفيزيائية والمجهرية على العينات. استخراج وتوثيق نتائج الفحوصات، والتخلص من العينات بعد الانتهاء من التحاليل مع توثيق إجراءات الإتلاف. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المختبرات الطبية. القدرة على التعامل مع المعدات المخبرية وتشغيلها وصيانتها الأساسية. معرفة جيدة بأسس حفظ العينات وإجراءات السلامة المخبرية. المهارات والكفاءات الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في إجراء الفحوصات وتحليل النتائج. مهارات تنظيمية جيدة لتوثيق البيانات والتقارير. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والالتزام بالبروتوكولات المعيارية. بيئة العمل سيعمل فني المختبر الطبي في بيئة مختبرية متخصصة في الرياض، ضمن فريق شركة دار المعدات الطبية والعلمية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بالمعايير المهنية في بيئة عمل ديناميكية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في الرياض. سيتم الإفصاح عن تفاصيل الراتب خلال عملية التوظيف.

9e7c9eacf6a73d5c.description: About Salehiya Healthcare Salehiya Healthcare, established in 1964, is a leading Saudi Arabian company specializing in the distribution of pharmaceuticals, medical and laboratory equipment, diagnostics, medical disposables, and hospital and consumer supplies. The company has evolved with the health sector in Saudi Arabia, meeting the demands of a growing market. Salehiya Healthcare operates from its main bases in Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam, with additional branches across the Kingdom, supported by a workforce of over 1000 employees. The Role of Manager, Outbound Logistics Salehiya Healthcare is seeking a Manager, Outbound Logistics to lead and optimize all outbound logistics activities for the company and its affiliates. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and is critical for ensuring the efficient, compliant, and timely distribution of pharmaceutical, medical, and healthcare products across the Kingdom. The Manager will uphold cold-chain and quality standards, drive operational excellence, and contribute to Salehiya Healthcare’s mission through innovative, digital, and customized logistics solutions. This position plays a key part in delivering superior service to customers, partners, and healthcare providers. Key Responsibilities Manage and oversee outbound logistics operations, including order fulfillment, dispatching, routing, transportation planning, fleet requirements, and delivery execution, through Outbound Logistics Supervisors. Guide the Outbound Logistics team (Supervisors, Officers, Coordinators, and Delivery Representatives) to maintain high standards of productivity, compliance, documentation, and customer service. Ensure full fleet compliance with cold chain handling, GDP standards, and regulatory requirements for pharmaceutical and medical product distribution. Implement operational controls and monitor KPIs, service levels, delivery accuracy, and reporting systems to ensure cost efficiency. Conduct periodic performance management reviews and route rides with delivery representatives to ensure SOP compliance and foster a customer-centric mindset. Utilize planning systems with relevant stakeholders for optimal and efficient delivery plans, ensuring accurate completion. Coordinate with Warehousing, Inventory, Transport, and Customer Service teams for smooth end-to-end operations. Develop and execute outbound logistics strategies, contributing to budgeting, forecasting, and cost-optimization initiatives. Lead outbound logistics projects, process improvements, automation initiatives, and innovation in cold-chain logistics to enhance efficiency and visibility. Monitor and improve maintenance, fuel consumption, and temperature calibration of the delivery fleet to prevent breakdowns. Oversee returns and recall processes, ensuring accurate collection by Delivery Representatives and processing by the Outbound Officer. Manage relationships with logistics partners, carriers, and third-party providers, ensuring alignment with service standards and SLAs. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in logistics management. Demonstrated experience in managing outbound logistics operations, preferably within the healthcare or pharmaceutical distribution sector. Strong understanding of cold-chain handling, GDP standards, and regulatory requirements. Proven ability to lead and develop a team, driving productivity and customer service. Experience with logistics planning systems and performance monitoring (KPIs, service levels). Work Environment and Culture Salehiya Healthcare is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that values all employees. The company encourages creativity and innovation, particularly in technology, by utilizing the latest tools and staying ahead of industry trends. Employees benefit from comprehensive training programs and mentorship opportunities designed to support professional growth and development within a welcoming atmosphere. The core values guiding Salehiya Healthcare's people are derived from its purpose to elevate the healthcare experience in the Kingdom.

Functional Tasks and Responsibilities: Monitor and oversee daily production operations and supervise production lines. Improve product quality and reduce production defects and errors. Monitor machines and ensure their readiness and compliance with quality and safety standards. Problem-solving and decision-making skills. Time management and commitment to production targets. Communication and coordination skills with relevant departments. 9e682660983fafcb.description: Job description: What We Offer Joining Red Sea Global [DEVCO]means becoming part of a visionary company dedicated to sustainable development and innovation in the projects we deliver. We foster an inclusive culture that values diversity, supports professional development, and encourages collaboration across all levels. As a member of our TPMO leadership team, you will have the opportunity to influence key strategic decisions, drive meaningful change, and contribute to high-impact projects that shape the future of the region. Position Title: Assistant Manager - DevCo Strategic Planning and Performance Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Division: Projects Delivery Department: Technical Project Management Office About the Role As the Assistant Manager for DevCo Strategic Planning and Performance, you will play a pivotal leadership role in shaping and driving the strategic direction and operational excellence of DevCo Operations within Red Sea Global. This role entails ownership of the entire strategy-to-execution chain, encompassing the formulation and maintenance of the business strategy, execution of a comprehensive strategic roadmap, oversight of the annual and three-year business planning cycles, and management of a portfolio of strategic initiatives designed to enhance performance and operational efficiency. You will serve as a key liaison between operational teams and executive management, synthesizing complex performance data into actionable insights and business decisions. Your expertise will foster a culture of continuous improvement through structured business analysis, scenario planning, and portfolio prioritization, ensuring alignment with broader Group objectives. Key Responsibilities Lead the development, periodic refresh, and review of the DevCo Operations business strategy, ensuring it is adaptive and forward-looking. Oversee the comprehensive annual and three-year business planning cycles, collaborating closely with cross-functional stakeholders to integrate financial and operational objectives. Lead the preparation, submission, and iterative review of the annual budget in partnership with Finance and Financial Planning & Analysis teams to ensure fiscal discipline and alignment with strategic goals. Maintain and continuously update the Strategic Initiatives Register, tracking progress, milestones, and benefit realization through to successful closure. Conduct detailed operational efficiency analyses, identify areas for improvement, and develop robust business cases to support enhancement initiatives. Design and manage a strategic performance framework that supports rigorous monitoring and evaluation, producing insightful Quarterly Business Review analyses to inform strategic decisions. Deliver comprehensive business analyses including options appraisal, scenario modeling, and benchmarking against industry best practices to guide strategic choices. Prepare executive-level reports, papers, and dynamic presentations that effectively translate data and analyses into clear strategic decisions for senior leadership. Ensure continuous alignment of DevCo Operations strategy, business plans, and performance metrics with the overarching Group direction and interrelated DevCo functions. Required Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a related discipline is required. Advanced degrees or relevant certifications are advantageous. 7 to 10 years of progressive experience, with a minimum of 4 years focused on corporate strategy, business planning, performance management, business analysis, or management consulting, preferably within complex project delivery environments. Technical and Professional Skills Corporate Strategy and Strategic Planning: Expert proficiency to support strategic development and drive implementation with agility. Business Analysis and Options Appraisal: Expert capability in dissecting business problems and evaluating alternatives to recommend sound solutions. Business Planning and Portfolio Prioritisation: Advanced skills to align projects and initiatives with strategic priorities effectively. KPI Framework Design and Performance Management: Advanced expertise to develop meaningful performance metrics that drive accountability and excellence. Executive Communication and Presentation Design: Expert-level skill in articulating complex information succinctly and convincingly to senior stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to develop analytical models and deliver high-impact executive-grade presentations. Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at multiple levels of the organization and work collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams. Proactive problem-solving approach with a focus on innovation and continuous improvement. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a strategic outlook.

Review cost absorption, material usage, labor efficiency, scrap, rework, and production overheads to ensure accurate product costing. Support profitability analysis, cost-saving initiatives, and operational performance improvement projects. Provide financial analysis and costing support for new products, process improvements, and operational initiatives. Support management by explaining manufacturing cost movements, operational variances, and financial impacts. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve inventory accuracy, production reporting, and cost management practices. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing manufacturing efficiency and financial performance. Compliance: Comply to related policy and procedures and work instructions. Health, Safety, and Environment: Ensure compliance of relevant safety, quality, and environmental management procedures and controls within defined area of work activity to guarantee safety, legislative compliance, and delivery of high-quality products/services. Academic Qualification Bachelor Degree in Accounting and Finance or Any relevant field Work Experience 4 to 6 Years Technical / Functional Competencies Financial Accounting (FI) Reconciliation Financial Reporting Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

9ec4c78fd5ac7514.description: About ASMO ASMO is a joint venture between DHL and Saudi Aramco, established to redefine procurement and supply chain services. The company leverages DHL’s logistics expertise and Saudi Aramco’s extensive supply chain ecosystem to provide integrated, end-to-end services. Initially focusing on Saudi Aramco and its affiliates, ASMO aims to serve industrial, energy, chemical, and petrochemical sectors across Saudi Arabia, with long-term plans to expand into the MENA region. Outbound Supervisor Role ASMO is seeking an Outbound Supervisor for its SPARK site in Buqayq, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for overseeing the safe, accurate, and efficient execution of outbound warehouse and yard processes during assigned shifts. The supervisor translates operational plans into daily execution by coordinating personnel, equipment, picking, staging, loading, dispatch activities, and system transactions. Key accountabilities include order execution, shipment accuracy, productivity, safety, quality, cut-off adherence, and timely escalation of issues. Key Responsibilities Lead daily outbound activities, including order release coordination, picking, packing (where applicable), staging, verification, loading, and dispatch confirmation. Allocate labor, Material Handling Equipment (MHE), staging space, and work priorities based on order urgency, transport schedules, cut-off times, and available capacity. Ensure correct material, quantity, condition, and documentation are prepared and shipped against approved customer orders. Control outbound exceptions such as shortages, holds, damaged material, picking discrepancies, loading issues, and transport delays, escalating promptly. Ensure Warehouse Management System (WMS) transactions are completed accurately and on time, aligning physical material movement with system status. Coordinate with inventory, inbound, yard, transport, planning, and customer service teams to resolve constraints and protect delivery commitments. Monitor outbound productivity, picking accuracy, staging backlog, loading performance, truck turnaround, and on-time dispatch. Lead shift start-up, floor control, operational problem-solving, and shift handover. Qualifications and Experience A high school diploma, technical diploma, vocational qualification, or equivalent practical background is acceptable. A bachelor’s or master’s degree is not mandatory. Candidates without a degree may be considered with at least 10 years of relevant, progressive, and verifiable warehouse or logistics experience, including substantial frontline leadership responsibility. 7–10 years of relevant warehouse, logistics, manufacturing, or industrial operations experience, with a minimum of 3 years leading or supervising frontline operational teams, is preferred. Operational competence, safety leadership, WMS capability, people supervision, inventory discipline, and measurable delivery results are prioritized. Warehouse operations, logistics, safety, MHE, WMS, Lean, or supervisory certifications are advantageous. Relevant equipment licenses are required if the role involves operating or directly controlling licensed equipment. Required Skills and Abilities Proven hands-on experience supervising picking, staging, loading, dispatch, and shipment verification in warehouse, manufacturing, industrial, or contract logistics operations. Practical experience leading frontline employees and coordinating labor, MHE, staging areas, and workload in a shift-based environment. Working experience with WMS or equivalent enterprise systems, including picking, loading, dispatch, and exception transactions. Demonstrated ability to control shipment accuracy, shortages, holds, documentation issues, safety risks, and operational backlog. Ability to use KPIs, daily management routines, and structured problem-solving to improve outbound performance.

9e6181511073c1d1.description: Job Description Join Us as a Clinical Trial Manager, managing studies locally in Saudi Arabia for one of our clients. Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation The Clinical Trial Manager is accountable for achieving the final clinical deliverable (usually clean data from evaluable patients as specified in the study protocol) within the time period specified in the contract with the customer. The Clinical Trial Manager interprets data on project issues and makes good business decisions with support from experienced team members or line manager. Works to ensure that all clinical deliverables meet the customer's time/quality/cost expectations. Maintains profitability by ensuring clinical activity is conducted within contract scope, through efficient management of the clinical team. The position involves working on projects of low to moderate complexity and as part of a team of CTMs. What You'll Do: Manage all clinical operational and quality aspects of allocated studies, of low to moderate complexity, in compliance with ICH GCP. In accordance to project specific requirements, may assume Clinical Study Manager (CSM) responsibilities on small and/or less complex projects. Develop clinical tools (e.g. Monitoring Plan, Monitoring Guidelines) in conjunction with the Data Quality Plan. Contribute to the development of the Master Action Plan (MAP) for providing clinical related documents. Ensure timely set up, organization, content and quality of the relevant sections of the Trial Master File (local and central). May participate in the design and development of CRFs, CRF guidelines, patient informed consent templates and other protocol specific documents as required. Collaborate with the project manager to prepare, organize, and present at client meetings, including bid defense and hand-off meetings. Collaborate with the clinical team and other departments as needed to meet deliverables of the project. Regularly communicate with the team and lead team meetings to ensure that timelines, resources, interactions, and quality are maintained. Responsible for the implementation and training of standardized clinical monitoring processes within the study and according to corporate standard policies. Responsible for the timely archiving of documents and study materials for the department. Ensure achievement of the final clinical deliverable within the contractual time period specified by preparing and monitoring clinical activity timelines and metrics, providing status updates to the project manager, regularly reviewing projects using tracking and management tools, implementing recovery actions, reviewing monitoring visit reports, and managing CRF collection and query resolution. Continuously monitor or co-monitors clinical trials to assess performance and ensure contractual obligations are met. In smaller regions, may routinely conduct Accompanied Field Visits (AFVs) and be accountable for project financials. May communicate with study sites regarding issues such as protocol, patient participation, case report form completion and other study-related issues. May coordinate all start-up activities and ensures that timely ethics committee and regulatory submissions (if appropriate) are addressed. Ensure that essential document quality meets the expectation of Regulatory Compliance Review. Review and follows up on all questions raised by the ethics committees. May provide input into preparation of forecast estimates for clinical activities.
